classification_contract.conservative: One or more observed non-opaque uncertainty reasons.
classification_contract.opaque: At least one observed opaque reason: eval_or_exec, reflection, constructed_attribute, native_boundary, monkey_patch, metaclass_mutation, or runtime_code_generation.
classification_contract.recording: Each SymbolRecord carries the closed confidence enum and sorted source-bound confidence_reasons metadata; affected dependency edges carry their own confidence.

identity_binding.source_cid: CIDv1 lowercase base32 sha2-256/raw over exact examined source bytes.
identity_binding.stable_symbol_id: CID over repository_id, language, normalized module path, qualified name, kind, and namespace.
identity_binding.symbol_version_cid: CID over stable identity, position-free normalized AST, signature, decorators, annotations, extractor identity/version, semantic-index schema, and property role.
identity_binding.self_verification: Closed SymbolRecord decoding recomputes stable and version identities; forged bound fields are rejected.

determinism_and_boundaries: The classifier only traverses a parsed Python AST and never imports or executes examined source.
Reasons are accumulated from source-bound calls, imports, class definitions, aliases, decorators, frontend notices, and direct local monkey patches, then stored sorted.
eval/exec, dynamic imports, reflection, constructed attributes, native boundaries, runtime class/code construction, metaclass mutation, and monkey patches are downgraded rather than claimed exact.
The existing frontend owns parsing, lexical scopes, declarations, diagnostics, and resource limits; the semantic index owns this confidence projection.
This is bounded static Python v1 analysis, not whole-CPython runtime equivalence, tracing, a formal proof system, or a canonical PCSM source-map authority.
selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: Current-head datasets already supplies the required versioned, CID-bound, deterministic Python-v1 dynamic-feature classification and its positive/negative tests. Reimplementation in proof_context would duplicate authority and violate the declared receipt-only output boundary.

limitations: This task is receipt-only: it selects existing current-head dynamic-feature risk authority and does not mutate proof_context or create a competing classifier.

The selected authority is bounded static Python AST analysis. It does not establish whole-CPython runtime semantics, actual dynamic-import results, reflection outcomes, native behavior, monkey-patch timing, metaclass effects, or generated-code correctness.
Confidence and identity values are valid only under the bound datasets source digests, schemas, extractor/CID profile, and examined source coordinates; any change invalidates this receipt.
The authoritative sealed suite remains unavailable because anyio is absent, so this receipt cannot promote completion.
The receipt's own canonical storage CID is unavailable because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
